portfolio.title: Our
portfolio.description: Explore a curated selection of our most ambitious desktop games, mobile experiences, and state-of-the-art web applications.

services.title: What We
services.description: We specialize in creating top-tier interactive experiences. From the adrenaline of gaming to the seamless utility of modern apps.
services.desktopGamesDesc: Engaging gameplay experiences designed specifically for PC and Steam releases, bringing polished, creative worlds to life.
services.mobileGamesDesc: Highly optimized mobile games tailored to captivate players on Android devices. (iOS compatibility coming soon).
services.webAppsDesc: State-of-the-art, responsive web platforms built with modern frameworks for exceptional user experiences.
services.mobileAppsDesc: Cross-platform hybrid mobile applications crafted meticulously with Flutter and React Native / Expo to scale your business.

about.paragraph1: At Orange Ember Studios, we believe that great software and great games are born from the same spark: an obsessive dedication to craftsmanship and user experience.
about.paragraph2: Our mission is to bridge the gap between high-end game development and premium web/mobile applications. Whether we're optimizing an engine for a desktop RPG or architecting a robust enterprise dashboard, our glowing ember of creativity never dims.

contact.title: Let's
contact.description: Whether you have a game prototype, an app idea, or just want to say hi, we're all ears. Drop us a message below.
contact.placeholderMessage: Tell us about your next big idea...
contact.successMessage: Your spark has been sent! We'll be in touch soon.
